1jdy0mk.description_en:
It is with deep disappointment that I send this message. A peerless contractor of ours was out on a job, but it seems like the target may have gotten the better of them.
I need you to travel to [LOCATION] and see if our contractor, [TARGET], is truly gone.
I suspect that the location will be somewhat chaotic since there will most likely still be multiple threats on site. Therefore, a supporting crew is strongly advised.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
1jdy0mk.description_zh:
我很遗憾地发送这条消息。我们一位出类拔萃的承包商在外执行任务时，好像目标占了上风。

我需要你前往 [LOCATION]，看看我们的承包商 [TARGETNAME] 是否真的没了。

我猜那里会有点乱，因为现场很可能还有多个威胁。因此，强烈建议你带个支援团队一起去。

此致，
沃恩

tgrmv9.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, [LOCATION], still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.
You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to 32 SCU in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to [DESTINATION].
Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.
tgrmv9.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

联合科学与开发公司(ASD)联系了我们，好像是他们以前的一个实验室，[LOCATION]，那里还存放着一些他们想要取回的物资。

你应该驾驶一艘能够能装下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱的飞船，降落在机库中，通过货运电梯装货，然后把所有东西运回 [DESTINATION]。

在设施那边的时候，一定要保持警惕，别让好奇心占了上风。像这样的废弃地点可能会藏着各种危险的东西。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

尽力做到最好 – 为你所做的工作感到自豪，这样你就会做出值得骄傲的成绩。

1fvtfqf.description_en:
To help protect our pilots, Citizens for Prosperity will often recommend the use of less traditional routes through the system. However, it seems that a gang of outlaws has gotten word and has begun to stage repeated ambushes along one such flightpath. Rather than just go around the problem and risk it persisting along the new route, we feel it we be prudent to meet these outlaws head on.
You and whatever support ships you enlist will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.
Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
1fvtfqf.description_zh:
为保护我方飞行员，繁荣公民常建议采用星系内不那么传统的航线。然而，似乎一伙不法分子已获悉此事，并开始在其中一条航线上反复设伏。与其绕行避险、任其隐患蔓延至新路线，我们更倾向于正面迎击这些不法分子。

你及你召集来的支援飞船需要前往 [LOCATION]，清除所有埋伏于此的敌对势力。据知，他们惯以小股编队行动，因此务必确保全部敌人都已被歼灭后方可撤离。

非常感谢您的帮助，
利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

1g9jlt7.description_en:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.
Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing.
That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.
GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter
So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to [LOCATION] to begin.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 1 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
1g9jlt7.description_zh:
想获得与各种目标和情况作战的关键实战经验吗？那我的战斗挑战可能正适合你。

请理解，这个课程是为那些已经掌握飞行基础、准备将技能提升到更高水平的飞行员设计的。如果你刚开始，想学习基础知识，我建议你在竞技指挥官模拟舱中多练习几小时。但对于那些准备迎接真正挑战的人，我坚信学生通过实践学习效果最好。

这就是为什么我设计了这八个场景，尽量做到尽可能真实。我向你保证，这将是你在不参军的情况下，最接近海军战斗飞行员训练的体验，所以不要指望会有人过多照顾。您自身或您飞船受伤的风险应当被极其严肃地对待。

挑战场景：
1. 单一目标
2. 复数目标
3. 目标优先级
4. 目标隐身
5. 导弹与对策
6. 多船员目标
7. 带护航的护卫舰
8. 主力舰遭遇战

所以，如果你准备好挑战自己并证明你有成为优秀飞行员的能力，第一场景将专注于处理单一目标。前往 [LOCATION] 开始。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证。

实战技巧：
- 情境意识 - 不要太专注于攻击目标以至于忽视了你的飞行路径。如果你一头撞上小行星，那就没什么意义了。

祝你好运，
教练吉利


关于吉利飞行学院
教练卢卡斯·“吉利”·巴拉姆斯科曾在六个飞行中队服役，拥有超过十年的教学经验。无论是零飞行经验的学生，还是希望提升技能的专业人士，吉利飞行学院都提供多种课程，帮助“开启你的飞行生涯”。

1s604sg.description_en:
We’ve lost contact with a supply convoy and are concerned it might be under attack. Last comm we received from them reported Shattered Blade ships were incoming, but haven’t heard anything since. Are you free to hurry to [LOCATION] and support our forces?
We’ve come to learn that the Shattered Blade are very protective of their hunting grounds. Our last few encounters with them were quite intense, so I’d recommend bringing some heavy firepower.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
1s604sg.description_zh:
我们与一支物资运输队失去了联系，担心他们可能正遭到攻击。我们最后收到的消息说，碎刃帮的飞船正在逼近，但从那以后就再没消息了。你现在有空的话，能赶紧赶到 [LOCATION] 支援我们的部队吗？

我们了解到，碎刃帮对他们狩猎地的保护非常严，最近几次和他们交手都挺激烈的，所以建议你带上足够的重火力。

利玛·恩迪科特

dh9xm0.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
dh9xm0.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

y9xofa.description_en:
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists are dedicated to keeping the delicate ecosystems of the empire in balance. A client recently hired us to evaluate the environmental impact of a number of invasive creatures near [LOCATION]. We’ve determined that to preserve the natural order of the region a conscientious culling of these species is necessary.
Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.
Best,
Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists
y9xofa.description_zh:
高境荒野专家致力于保持帝国脆弱生态系统的平衡。最近，一位客户雇佣我们评估 [LOCATION] 附近多种入侵生物对环境的影响。我们已确定，为了保护该地区的自然秩序，有必要对这些物种进行有意识的猎杀。

我们正在寻找能够并愿意参与这一努力的人。有关目标生物的更多信息，请在你的日志中参考《斯坦顿野生动物指南》。

祝好，

旺达·沃克海瑟
合约经理
高境荒野专家

19p6kdq.description_en:
[TARGET] was a name that proved particularly troublesome for some time. Whether a master of evasion or just unerringly lucky all of our attempts have thus far failed.
With that being said, it seems that someone else may have beaten us to the punch so to speak. We’d like you to visit [LOCATION] and confirm if the target has indeed been neutralized. But be advised, I suspect they’re former crew may still be in the area, most likely out of a misplaced sense of loyalty. I’d suggest a crew of your own for this one, but will defer to your expertise.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
19p6kdq.description_zh:
[TARGETNAME] 这个名字曾经让我们头疼了好一阵子。不管他是逃避大师还是运气好到没话说，我们所有尝试都到目前为止失败了。

话虽如此，看来似乎有人抢先我们一步了。我们希望你去 [LOCATION] 确认一下目标是否真的被干掉了。不过得提醒你一下，我怀疑他之前的船员可能还在这附近，大概是因为错把忠诚当回事儿。我建议你自己带个队伍去，不过具体怎么安排就看你专业了。

此致，
沃恩

1b14nw8.description_en:
Get this, we were sifting through some comms and picked up some excitement about a big score. It was easy work to figure out where they're hiding a ship loaded with cargo and we figured, hey, why keep this profitable knowledge to ourselves?
Send us a few creds in finder fees and we'll send you the coordinates of the asteroid base where the ship is stashed. It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.
57 65 65 76 69 6c
1b14nw8.description_zh:
听着，我们在筛查一些通讯时，捕捉到了一些关于一笔丰厚交易的激动消息。找出他们藏匿着的一艘装满物资的飞船的地方很简单，我们想，嘿，为什么要把这种有利可图的消息藏起来呢？

给我们打点信用点作为信息费，我们就会把飞船所在的小行星基地的坐标发给你。飞船被锁在一个机库里，所以你需要通过站内的电梯到达那里。但一旦你进去之后，你就可以在控制台上覆盖锁定。做到这一点后，就可以轻松获取到他了。

57 65 65 76 69 6c

u3s9o8.description_en:
Hi,
So I had a contractor who was supposed to deliver some stuff for us but has completely gone off the radar. I've pinged their ship and I've got no idea what's happened but they're floating around somewhere over at [LOCATION]. If you could head over there recover the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] you'd be doing me a huge favor.
Don't forget to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam to move all the cargo. Oh and a ship that can transport [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

嗨，

别忘了带把重型牵引光束，不然搬不动；另外船得能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱才行。

wtj7x5.description_en:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.
One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION] and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.
Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.
Fly safe out there,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
wtj7x5.description_zh:
边境生活艰难，每一次给我们定居者的补给都至关重要，今年我们真的不能再有更多损失了。

在 [LOCATION] 有位我们的关键供应商遭到一伙不法分子袭击，此后便彻底失联。我担心最坏的情况已经发生，但如果还能抢回他们当时运输的物资，那将意义重大。

袭击他们的不法分子很可能仍潜伏在附近，务必提高警惕。等你清理掉他们后，尽快取走货物，并运送到 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯。请确保你驾驶的飞船能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，同时务必配备一把 重型牵引光束。

祝你在那飞行平安，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

5mj74d.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
All your digging around Onyx has paid off. I’ve been able to confirm that Jorrit has been operating an off-the-record lab in the facility’s Site-B in order to conduct an experiment he calls “Project Hyperion.” I’ll send his lab notes to your mobiGlas journal once you’re underway, but the long and short of it is the bastard is trying to make Humans evolve or some nonsense like that.
The client wants the experimental data, so you’re going back to Onyx and do everything needed to get Project Hyperion up and running.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Prep the experiment by collecting a Reagent code from the Engineering wing and a Catalyst code from the Research wing.
Once you have those, head down to the Lab in Site-B and run the experiment so you can upload the results.
Additional Notes:
Since this is an active lab, there might be ASD security on-site.
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
5mj74d.description_zh:
霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
你在玛瑙设施的深入调查终于有了收获。我已确认乔里特一直在站点-B 秘密运营着一个未登记的实验室，进行他称之为“海伯利安项目”的实验。等你出发后，我会把他的实验笔记发送到你的 mobiGlas 日志中，简单来说，这个混蛋想让人类进化，或者诸如此类的荒唐事。

客户需要这些实验数据，所以你得重返玛瑙设施，完成一切必要步骤，启动“海伯利安项目”。

合约调查员的行动：
先去工程区获取反应物代码，再去研究区获取催化剂代码，为实验做好准备。

拿到代码后，前往站点-B 的实验室，运行实验，然后上传实验结果。

补充说明：
由于这是个仍在运作的实验室，现场可能有联合科学与开发公司的安保人员。

前往玛瑙设施时，请使用可停放在大型机库的载具。

Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
Thanks to that last batch of data you delivered, we’re starting to fill in the gaps on what Dr. Jorrit’s doing down there. Got a rough timeline of his activities. Seems he’s had more stuff coming into Onyx than going out which is interesting. We’re going to need more intel though. There’s an old experiment running down there that monitors minute seismic changes. If you can deliver that data to me, it’ll help us pinpoint some of the movement around the facility.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Research wing and retrieve the Seismic data and deliver it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

ctrzrp.description_en:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that [LOCATION] is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4>. It won't stand.
Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including any friendly ships in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.
Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw 2 Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig.
- Stows
ctrzrp.description_zh:
不跟你啰嗦那些细节，但信我，[LOCATION] 对猎头帮来说至关重要。所以你知道当我听说那帮不知天高地厚的愣头青正疯狂骚扰他们、一心想把他们的 [OBJECTS] 给毁了时，我有多火大吗？这事儿没门！

赶紧过去，在一切被毁之前提供保护，包括周边任何需要帮忙的任何友方飞船。像这种脑残家伙，对你这种冉冉升起的新星来说应该算不上什么挑战吧。

把他们全给我收拾干净，谁接了这活儿，我就扔给他 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

unhzq6.description_en:
Hey, it’s El.
Got a client at [LOCATION], who needs their cargo picked up from Ruin Station. They’ve been waiting there a while and are starting to get a bit impatient. Any chance you could handle this for us?
You’ll need a ship that can fit 24 SCU cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam to be able to move them.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
unhzq6.description_zh:
嘿，是我，艾尔。

你需要一艘能装 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 货物集装箱的飞船，还要配一把 手持式牵引光束 才能搬运那些集装箱。

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”


科瓦莱什货运是一家有限责任公司。为了促进及时交付并防止货运欺诈，科瓦莱什货运会设定一个交货期限，一旦超过这个期限，任何未交付的货物都会被视为被盗并按盗窃处理。总付款会根据成功交付的货物百分比按比例支付。

A group of prospectors set out to look for some mining opportunities and haven’t been heard from since. We’re looking for someone to check in and see if they’re okay.

Battaglia, Recco

我会给你发送他们最后已知的位置。请直接前往该处，查看究竟发生了什么事。

报酬：
确认全体成员状态后，按标准列出的费率结算。

雷科·巴塔利亚

w86vix.description_en:
If you happen to be in the area, please read this.
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for a qualified mechanic to head to [LOCATION] with the required supplies and perform some repairs.
As it stands, you’ll need six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to repair five pipes or so. That should help us get the outpost functional again. We'll compensate you for your time and materials.
If you need more information on maintenance work, see “Cornerstone Developments' Guide to Maintenance” entry in your mobiGlas Journal.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
w86vix.description_zh:

这些物资将协助恢复前哨站运转。我们将补偿您的时间与材料损耗。

维修细则请参照 mobiGlas 日志中 《基石开发公司维修指南》 条目。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

1wnj3a3.description_en:
To all available contractors,
We at Rayari are stopping at nothing to halt the ongoing regeneration crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need a rare resource that the company's suppliers cannot obtain.
Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather irradiated valakkar pearls, which can be extracted from apex valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have found a qualifying population inside the storm near [LOCATION]. Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is prepared to generously compensate anyone who can assist with gathering the pearls.
Once attained, please take these valuable resources to [DESTINATION].
Together we can make the universe better for all.
Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing
1wnj3a3.description_zh:
致所有有空的承包商，

我们拉亚利正在不遗余力地阻止当前的再生危机，但我们的科学家需要一种罕见的资源，而公司供应商无法获取这种资源。

拉亚利正在寻找有经验的承包商来收集 受辐射的瓦拉卡珍珠，这些珍珠可以从长期暴露在辐射下的巅峰期瓦拉卡体内提取。我们的扫描发现，在靠近 [LOCATION] 的风暴中有一批符合条件的种群。因为这些动物极其危险，拉亚利准备慷慨地补偿任何能够协助收集珍珠的人。

一旦收集完成，请将这些珍贵的资源送到 [DESTINATION]。

携手共进，我们可以让宇宙变得更美好。

纳丽娜·勒雷姆
高级经理
临床研究外包

wp4b97.description_en:
We’ve got clients reporting outlaw attacks on ships around [LOCATION]. They got locked down tight and anybody heading in or out is a target. Any attempts to solve the issue have just been met with more outlaw reinforcements appearing.
The client is desperate for a solution, so we’re hiring a contractor to go and restore peace in the area. If any other issues flare up once you're there, I’ll comm you directions on how to help.
Really need someone on this fast. So to sweeten the pot, the main contractor will also get a bonus payment of 5 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
wp4b97.description_zh:
我们接到客户报告，说 [DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION] 附近的飞船正遭到不法分子的袭击。他们那边已经全面封锁，任何进出的人都成了目标。之前试图解决问题的尝试，只是引来了更多的不法分子增援。

客户急需一个解决方案，所以我们正在雇佣一位承包商去那里恢复秩序。如果你到了之后有其他问题冒出来，我会通过通讯器告诉你如何处理。

真的需要有人赶紧接手这个任务。因此为了增加吸引力，主承包商还将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

1gpmee.description_en:
Hey, it’s El.
Need a reliable contractor for a pretty important delivery today. I’m sure you’re aware of what went down in Orison, big commotion. Made my job about ten times harder.
Anyway, we’ve been contracted by Crusader to deliver some medical stuff to [DESTINATION]. Pick up’s at [LOCATION]. Shouldn’t be too heavy an order for this one, just make sure you’ve got a ship that can hold 1 SCU cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam, or you’ll really embarrass yourself when you get there.
Look, I’ll level with you. This job isn’t just hauling for hauling’s sake. Orison got pretty messed up by those Nine Tails, so anything we can do to help them out is probably the right thing to do.
Let’s get it done,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
1gpmee.description_zh:
嘿，我是艾拉。

今天，需要一位可靠的承包商来完成一项相当重要的运送任务。想必你已经知道奥里森发生了什么，大骚乱。让我的工作难度增加了十倍。

总之，我们受十字军委托，需将一些医疗物资运送至 [DESTINATION]，取货地点在 [LOCATION]。这次订单重量应该不算太重，但务必确保你的飞船能装载 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的货物，并带上一把手持牵引光束，否则到了那儿你会很尴尬的。

我跟你说句心里话，这项任务绝非为了运货而运货。奥里森被那些九尾搞得一团糟，所以任何能帮上忙的事都是正确的选择。

让我们尽力而为，

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

ar274a.description_en:
We've heard news that a new gang are planning an attack on a place over at [LOCATION]. They figure if they can take out the fuel supplies there then it's theirs for the taking.
But little do they know that we're gonna send you in first to blow the fuel tanks so we can claim the place before they do. If it all goes to plan, we can clear the location out and stick it to that gang at the same time. Two birds, one stone.
Only problem is this place is armed to the teeth. Bring a crew and get those fuel tanks out of action. We'll take care of the rest.
-Stows out
ar274a.description_zh:
我们听说一伙新帮派正计划进攻 [LOCATION] 那块地方。他们盘算着只要端掉那里的燃料补给，那地儿就归他们了。

但他们不知道的是，我们要先派你去把那些油罐炸了，好在他们动手前把地盘占下来。要是按计划行事，咱们既能清空那块地，又能顺便给那帮混蛋点颜色看看，一举两得。

唯一的麻烦是那儿武装到了牙齿。带上一个团队去把那些燃料罐搞定，剩下的交给我们。

-斯托斯通讯完毕

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION
The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.
NAME: [TARGET]
SYSTEM: Stanton
RISK ASSESSMENT: Medium
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: [LOCATION]
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: <None>
NOTES: This preliminary bounty is being offered to you as a formal evaluation of your skills. Successful completion of this contract will lead to additional bounty work being made available.
It is believed that the target will be on foot and well armed, so be prepared to engage in a firefight. Additionally, there may be other hostiles forces at the site, while they should not be your primary focus, you may have to engage with them while in pursuit of the target.
BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice
The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: One of our pilots is under attack at [LOCATION] and is in need of assistance.
This operative is carrying key information regarding a coordinated attack on key UEE infrastructure and it is vital that they are able to deliver it to us. You and any dependable pilots you can recruit are charged with protecting them from the outlaws in pursuit long enough for them to QT away.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.
5oztfb.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：我们的一名飞行员在 [LOCATION] 受到了攻击，急需援助。

这名特工携带了关于针对 UEE 关键基础设施协同攻击的重要信息，他们必须把信息送到我们手上。你和任何你能招募到的可靠飞行员负责保护他，让他摆脱追击的不法分子，直到他量子航行离开。

此致，

迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通信内容包含机密内容，仅限收件人阅读。如误收请忽略并通知发件人。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并须遵守适用的 UEE 及星系法律。

1l3461o.description_en:
Ship support is needed at [LOCATION] immediately. Our client’s interests in the area are under fierce attack by outlaw forces. Looking for someone who can grab their gear, a few support ships they can trust, and deploy before it’s too late. Once you arrive, I’ll send any sitrep updates your way.
Don’t mess this up. These clients are paying for and expecting top tier protection. If anything goes wrong, we could lose this contract. That’s why we’ll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 8 MG Scrip if all goes down without a hitch.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
1l3461o.description_zh:
[DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION] 急需飞船支援。我们客户在该地区的利益正遭到不法分子的猛烈攻击。我们需要一个能迅速行动的人，带上装备、几艘值得信赖的支援飞船，赶在情况恶化之前部署到位。你到达之后，我会把最新的局势报告发给你。

别搞砸了。这些客户可是花了钱买顶级保护的，他们也期待得到相应的服务。如果出任何差错，我们可能就会丢掉这个合约。所以，如果一切顺利，我们会给主承包商发放 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

iog59i.description_en:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an [TARGET] and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near [LOCATION]. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack.
Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the [TARGET] is aggressive and battle hardened.
You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of 16 MG Scrip in it for the main contractor.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
iog59i.description_zh:
我们收到了一些关于 [AMBUSHTARGET] 及其护航船最近发动攻击的通讯。在打开一个文件后，我们开始追踪这艘船的动向，发现它经常经过靠近 [LOCATION] 的辐射云。我们想利用这一点发起一次突袭。

一旦到达现场，你应该藏身于辐射云中，以足够掩盖你的信号，争取先发制人。不幸的是，福克斯韦尔无法为这次行动提供额外的增援，所以你需要负责带来任何支援力量。你可能也需要帮助。这支 [AMBUSHTARGET] 的队伍非常好斗且战斗经验丰富。

帮我们搞定这事，就给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证 当奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
A Red Wind hauler has been ambushed by some outlaws and now our clients’ cargo is sitting still whilst they prepare to steal it. We need a pilot with a heavy-duty tractor beam and a combat ready ship to head to the location below and recover the cargo before it’s gone for good.
RECOVERY LOCATION
· [LOCATION]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at [DESTINATION]
The pilot reported multiple hostiles so make sure you take this seriously.
EVERY OPPORTUNITY COUNTS – Make the most of what’s given to you, show us that you can handle more work.
1ry1t3w.description_zh:

找回地点
     · [LOCATION]

卸货地点
     · [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯

飞行员报告称有多个敌对目标，务必认真对待。

每一个机会都至关重要，充分利用现有资源，向我们证明你能胜任更多任务。

vk8ogu.description_en:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.
The fools are operating from [LOCATION]. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.
- Stows out.
vk8ogu.description_zh:
一些混蛋拒绝支付我们应得的报酬。问题是，这些蠢货还到处炫耀。要是他们保持沉默的话我们还能用更有效方法解决这个问题，但现在我们需要给他们个下马威。

这帮蠢货在 [LOCATION]。我们需要他们全部消失，动静越大越好，等所有人都处理干净了，我们会把你的报酬发过去。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

Our friends at [LOCATION] have been compromised. A new gang in the area are threatening them by targeting their [OBJECTS].
If those get destroyed its going to be seriously bad for business, so I want you over there pronto on protection duty.
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding 4 Council Scrip for the main contractor.
- Stows

要是你还缺点动力的话，那么我给主承包商额外加了 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为奖励。

5eaofv.description_en:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to [LOCATION] when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.
I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers.
Appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

我会指示我们的商人在未来更注意合作对象，但目前我非常感谢你能帮他们抵御这些攻击者。

谢谢，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

r4ms02.description_en:
Any interest in taking out a [TARGET] for us?
Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by [LOCATION] soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.
They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.
You pull this off and I'll toss 3 Council Scrip to the main contractor for a job well done.
- Stows
r4ms02.description_zh:
有兴趣帮我们解决掉 [AMBUSHTARGET] 吗？

应该不会太麻烦。我们已经踩好点了，发现他们很快就会经过 [LOCATION]。你只需要藏在附近的辐射云里，就能打他们个措手不及。

目标可能是单枪匹马或带着几个帮手，都是单座战机但空战能力不俗。等交火开始后，我们会派些人手过去支援。

你要是能把这事儿办成了，我会给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为报酬。

- 斯托斯

4inwv7.description_en:
A senior security official by the name of [TARGET] is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at [LOCATION], they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.
I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter.
Earnestly,
Vaughn
4inwv7.description_zh:
一名叫做 [TARGETNAME] 的资深安保人士马上就要在从天而降的暴力之中和他的职业生涯告别了。他们目前驻扎在 [LOCATION]，并且不会很好对付。恐怕你需要费一番功夫才能引他们出来了。

我推荐击杀足够多的手下，他们就别无选择只能亲自出来迎战你。当然了，一旦他们决定露面，事情就很好办了。

你真诚的，
沃恩

1labima.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.
Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
1labima.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

需要一名飞行员，将货物从 [LOCATION] 的货物电梯运输到 [DESTINATION]。
只要你的飞船能装下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，这项任务应该很简单。

几乎没有比这更轻松的赚取信用点的方法了。只要小心点，因为这条路线可不是最安全的区域。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

gnkwxm.description_en:
Well done!
With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.
This next section will help you familiarize yourself with [LOCATION] and take you to visit [STORENAME], a weapons store here in [LOCATION].
You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.
gnkwxm.description_zh:
干得漂亮！

在完成了教程的第一部分后，您现在应该对基础移动控制、自身饥渴状态管理、还有一些mobiGlas的核心功能——即合约管理和日志都有所了解了。

接下来的部分将会帮您熟悉一下 [LOCATION]，并带您去逛一下 [LOCATION] 的武器店 [STORENAME]。

您可以使用联合地球信劵（UEC）在这些商店中进行购物。在星际公民的阿尔法测试阶段，我们会使用名为aUEC（阿尔法联合地球信劵）的货币。这是一种专门用于测试游戏内经济和平衡系统的临时货币。

krgwtb.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
krgwtb.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

n6nyw3.description_en:
Hey again,
I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
n6nyw3.description_zh:
嘿你好，

我有一个在 [LOCATION] 那的信标，这次的任务比平时复杂一些。有一支小型舰队请求补充 [FUELTYPE]。他们协调性好的出奇，计划性又差得离谱。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

1ywtpxp.description_en:
Hey!
DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.
The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.
And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.
If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out.
A Club member has run out of [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST]. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their [SHIP] and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a journal entry on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.
There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates.
Looking forward to working with you.
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
1ywtpxp.description_zh:
嘿！

我是来自旅者联合俱乐部的 DD。

UWC 在全 UEE 范围内提供维修、补给和加油服务。碰巧我们正在寻找新的合作伙伴，只要你的飞船配备了加油设备。如果你拥有燃料吊舱，并且喜欢被人热情迎接，那么 UWC 可能很适合你来。

如果你觉得这不错，那我手头正好有一个正在运行的信标你可能喜欢。

如果你确实喜欢它，那么给你一个提醒：出发前务必确保燃料吊舱已满。

一名俱乐部成员在 [LOCATION] 那边耗尽了 [FUELTYPE]。具体细节我还不太清楚，比如他们怎么就跑到那儿连“动力果汁”都没了，但 UWC 不想把大家晾在一边不管。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

这是一趟很简单的活儿。如果你想感受熟悉这类工作，这再合适不过了。去那里给他们的 [SHIP] 加满油，然后让他们启程吧。多做几次这样的任务，操作就会变成肌肉记忆。在此之前，你的 mobiGlas 里有一篇名为“加油协议”的日志条目，涵盖了所有基础内容。

该区域尚未报告有不法分子活动，但仍需保持警惕。我始终建议你追求快速周转。越早完成，我就越能尽快为你安排下一份合约。UWC 一直在寻找新的合作伙伴。

期待与你合作，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

sgrfnl.description_en:
Here's the deal, we just got word that a XenoThreat power player named [TARGET] just came out of hiding and was spotted at [LOCATION].
Headhunters have been hungry to put this asshole in the ground for months, so we launched an assault against the outpost, but the Judge wants to make sure [TARGET] doesn't slip away, so they want to use you as insurance.
This'll be a tough kill in the middle of a warzone, but we'll pay out if you pull it off.
Stows out.

在战区里应该很难击杀他，但如果你成功，我们会支付报酬。

12xo1dr.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for a heavy Antium armor set. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
12xo1dr.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM]

完成此任务以获取安腾护甲套装的蓝图。在本次测试中，这些蓝图包含若干插槽，可接受不同材料以获得不同的属性调整。

1bcj2ga.description_en:
Hi,
Need the trash collected from a few Hurston locations and then taken to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. Don't worry, none of the containers are bigger than 8 SCU.
PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION1]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION2]
- Freight elevator at [LOCATION3]
Fun fact for you. Hurston is the only planet in Stanton that doesn’t separate their trash and scrap. One of their workers told me that the company did a cost-benefit analysis on it decades ago that determined it wasn’t worth putting a planet-wide system in place to facilitate it. Isn’t that the most Hurston thing ever?
By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
